_note: Feature cells = what each app's own Google Play listing states (checked 18 Sep 2026). '—' means the listing does not mention it. Pillar row from the product.

apps.name: Pillar
apps.bestFor: Indian-language choice, ready-made companions and starting without email or phone
apps.limit: Android only for now; iOS is coming.

apps.name: Urvashi
cells: 11 (Hindi, Hinglish, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu)
apps.bestFor: an Indian-language AI girlfriend with photos and memory
apps.limit: Its listing does not mention voice calls or games.

apps.name: Meetra
cells: 9 (Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu) plus foreign languages
apps.bestFor: calls, notes, custom photos, memory and games
apps.limit: Its listing does not say it messages first.

apps.name: Saathiya
apps.bestFor: Hindi chat with Ludo built in
apps.limit: Its listing does not mention voice, photos or memory.

apps.name: DashTalk
apps.bestFor: voice calls — it is built around calling
apps.limit: Fewer languages than the others here.

apps.name: TeriBandi
apps.bestFor: a simple Hindi/Hinglish companion with several personalities
apps.limit: Its listing lists few features beyond chat.

apps.name: Desi Avtar
apps.bestFor: AI calls plus a way to meet real people in the same app
apps.limit: It mixes AI companions with a social feature — a different product if you only want a companion.

apps.name: HeartEcho
apps.bestFor: Hindi voice calls in a companion (rather than girlfriend) framing
apps.limit: Its listing focuses on Hindi and Hinglish.

global.name: Character AI
global.bestFor: trying thousands of user-made characters and roleplay
global.limit: Not built around one persistent Indian companion; no Indian-language focus.

global.name: Replika
global.bestFor: a long-running companion with voice and an avatar

global.name: Nomi
global.bestFor: memory and group chats with several companions
